PM Activities Performed Semiannually: Visually inspect insulating material for cracks and detached pieces. Visually inspect the nacelle for cracks, tightness, and lighting. Visually inspect the attachment of the nacelle/base frame, rail, weather station, and navigation lights, grounding strip, and ventilation system. Check the tightness of the nacelle enclosure fasteners. Visually inspect the ground cable for corrosion, connection, and electrical contact.

Visually inspect the nacelle hinged cover for missing or loose parts and to ensure that it seals properly. Visually inspect the tread of the steps and grating to ensure tight connections and no accumulation of dirt and for corrosion/physical damage.
